title: Harsha Engineers (HARSHA) - LIVE deep dive #6, first capital-goods draw (protocol v1.4, stages 2-7): method test, no verdict; card v1.5 size 0; 6 live calls
body: LIVE method test (L9, L21): random draw (Random(20261203)) from 262 IT (38) / Chemicals (72) / Capital Goods (152) names in the India Rs 1,000-20,000 cr band at the 23-Nov-2026 close, classified by industry_map.csv (0 unclassified; prereg sha256 47b2b58e... written before the frame). SKIPS: none - HARSHA was walk #1. S2 passed: unmodified FY26 audit (auditor rotation at term end), CARE AA- (Mar-2024; no later filing found), pledge 0, promoter 75%, solvency not red (2 flags), PEAD Q5 (SUE +1.81). FINDINGS: (1) India Engineering EBITDA 22-24% but group ROIC ~11.5% and ROIIC ~11% (Romania losses, solar, ~135-day working capital, new plants) - below CoE 12.5%; (2) ~Rs 600 cr capex wave (Advantek Bhayla phases 1-2 'Rs 350 cr plus', China phase 2 ~Rs 100 cr) while Advantek runs at ~54% utilisation (Reg-30 28-May-2026); payback by utilisation vs management's 2x asset-turn route differs ~6x; (3) AGM 23-Jul-2026: 14.14% against re-appointing ID Kunal Shah = ~92% of non-promoter votes cast [EST]; (4) L40: debt 'backed by government subsidy' per the call, no grant/subsidy note in AR26; solar ALMM relaxations to Dec-2026; (5) one customer 12.6% of revenue (11.0% FY25); (6) credibility hand ledger 57% vs auto-components median 60% (numbers met, dates slip); (7) MD&A segment table mislabels the FY26 EBITDA column. VALUATION (worksheet v1.3): Rs 438.25, 24.4x trailing, 43.8x normalised; reverse DCF finds no growth path at ROIIC 14% - needs year-10 NOPAT margin 24.5% vs 9.0%; base IRR 8.7%; DCF-consistent exit P/E ~10.6 vs 24 used (EV 0.73x at DCF exits); EV 1.58x raw = anchored (w=0.5) vs hurdle 1.76x -> size 0. Both-flags (L39 addendum) not triggered (pledge 0, ICR 9.6x). Calls: 6 live + 3 card calls.

title: HARSHA variant view (method test): price is a bet that ~Rs 600 cr of new capacity earns far above the group's ~11% ROIIC
body: At Rs 438 (24.4x trailing) the reverse DCF finds no growth path at historical ROIIC that justifies the price; the market is paying for India-Engineering-style returns (22-24% EBITDA) on Advantek/China capacity that today runs at ~54% utilisation. No claimable mispricing; the testable question is group ROIC >= 14% on FY28 numbers and Advantek PAT-positive for two half-years. Evidence leans sceptical (utilisation, delayed bushing contract, Romania, subsidy not disclosed, ~92% minority dissent on an ID). Not advice.

data.changes_mind: Advantek PAT+ two half-years and group ROIC >= 14% on FY28

title: A strong segment margin can hide a group ROIC below the cost of equity; rebuild payback by utilisation, not management's asset turn
body: HARSHA live dive #6: India Engineering EBITDA 22-24% but group ROIC ~11.5% and 5-yr ROIIC ~11% (loss-making Romania plant, solar EPC, ~135-day working capital, new plants at ~54% utilisation). When ROIIC ~ CoE, growth adds ~no DCF value: the reverse DCF finds no growth path and the DCF-consistent exit P/E falls to ~10x, so the whole price premium is a bet on returns on new capital. Technique: (1) compute group ROIC = EBIT ex other income x (1-t) / (equity + debt - liquid assets) and ROIIC over 5 years before reading segment margins; (2) for a capex phase, compute payback two ways - management's asset-turn route (capex x claimed turn x margin) and the utilisation route (current revenue / capital employed at today's utilisation) - a large gap is the question to track (HARSHA ~6x).

title: Read minority dissent as against / (votes cast - promoter shares); a 14% headline can be ~92% of the free float that voted
body: HARSHA AGM 23-Jul-2026: re-appointment of ID Kunal Shah passed with 14.14% against (11.40 m of 80.61 m). Promoters hold 68.28 m (75%); if they all voted for, non-promoters cast ~12.3 m votes of which ~92% were against [EST; scrutiniser report has no category split]. With 70-75% promoter holdings a special resolution cannot fail, so the headline understates dissent. Rule: in the L5 vote-results table report (a) promoter shares held vs votes polled (L40) and (b) non-promoter dissent = against / (total cast - promoter votes); flag any resolution with non-promoter dissent > 50% and look for proxy-adviser reports.

title: Decision card HARSHA 2026-11-25 (paper)
body: Decision card v1 for Harsha Engineers International Ltd (precision bearing cages, bushings, stampings; solar EPC). Rule output: size 0: blocked by Expected value vs hurdle (EV 1.58x anchored (raw 1.58x) vs hurdle 1.76x → below hurdle → size 0). Thesis: Method-test thesis: Harsha Engineers is the largest independent maker of precision bearing cages (steel, brass, polyamide; 20-2,000 mm), selling mainly to a handful of global bearing majors from Ahmedabad (Changodar, Moraiya, Bhayla), Changshu (China) and Ghimbav (Romania), plus bushings for wind gearboxes, stampings and a solar-EPC side business (~11% of revenue, ~5% of EBITDA). India Engineering earns ~22-24% EBITDA margins; the group earns ~11.5% ROIC because of Romania losses, a working-capital-heavy model (~135 days) and a Rs ~600 cr capex wave (Advantek Bhayla phases 1-2, China phase 2) that is still ramping. The 5-year outcome depends on whether that capex earns well above its recent ~11% incremental return. Variant view: Market: at Rs 438 the stock trades at 24.4x trailing P/E and 14.3x EV/EBITDA - below its short listed history (FY23-26 FY-end median 28.8x) and well below bearing makers (43-50x), near the closest chain peer Rolex Rings (22.1x). Analysts on the Q2 FY27 call asked about Romania downsizing, the conservative H2 guidance, metal pass-through and Advantek breakeven; nobody asked about group ROIC or the utilisation of the capacity being built. Our read: the worksheet's reverse DCF finds no growth path at the historical ~11-14% ROIIC that justifies the price - it needs a year-10 NOPAT margin of ~24.5% (vs 9.0% now) on the base growth path, i.e. the market is already paying for India-Engineering-style returns on the new capital. Evidence against that: Advantek runs at ~54% utilisation (Reg-30 28-May-2026) yet is adding 12 m pieces (Rs 110 cr) and 'Rs 350 cr plus' in total; the Rs 117 cr/yr bushing contract (Aug-2025) is 'a little bit delayed'; Romania has missed operating breakeven targets since FY25; FY26 CFO was Rs 68 cr on Rs 278 cr EBITDA. Evidence for: India Engineering +23% in H1 FY27 with 23.7% EBITDA margin, outsourcing projects worth Rs 75 cr + Rs 75-100 cr in the pipeline, a strategic sourcing deal with a European major, net cash ~Rs 95 cr, CARE AA- (Mar-2024), promoter 75% unpledged. No claimable mispricing: we have no information edge on customer outsourcing decisions; the question we can track (utilisation and ROIC on the new capex) is dated and public. Departure from the outside view: raw P(blow-up) 5% is below the class 15% (strong balance sheet, AA- rating, no pledge) - anchored at the default w=0.5, which raises it; we do not claim enough evidence to go below 0.5. Checked by paper calls thesis:paper-call:HARSHA:*. Open soft flags: 4. P(≥3x) 10% vs base 21%; P(≤0.5x) 9% vs base 11.3%; EV 5-yr multiple 1.58x vs hurdle 1.76x. Review 2027-02-15.
